sections.title: Yokonuma–Hecke Algebras
sections.extract: Yokonuma–Hecke algebras were introduced by Yokonuma [Yo] for the same reason that Ariki–Koike alge- bras were introduced by Ariki and Koike: as generalisations of Iwahori–Hecke algebras.
